title: Rate of Change in Context
student_objective: I can calculate and interpret rate of change from tables, graphs, and equations, including correct units and direction.

lesson_flow.label: Watch Tolux calculate and interpret rates
Find and interpret rates with Tolux

concept_cards.title: Rate of change is slope in context
concept_cards.content: Rate of change compares how much the output changes for each 1-unit change in the input. It is Δy/Δx.

concept_cards.title: Units matter
concept_cards.content: A rate should name output units per input unit, such as dollars per hour, miles per minute, or gallons per day.

concept_cards.title: Positive, negative, or zero
concept_cards.content: Positive rate means the output increases, negative rate means it decreases, and zero rate means it stays constant.

concept_cards.title: Read from tables, graphs, and equations
concept_cards.content: Find slope from any representation, then translate that slope into a sentence about the real situation.

interpret.teacher_signal: Student gives a number without context meaning.

items.prompt: A car travels 120 miles in 3 hours at a constant rate. What is the rate in miles per hour?
items.tutor_behavior: Divide output change by input change.

items.prompt: A tank loses 10 gallons in 2 hours. Is the rate of change positive or negative?
items.tutor_behavior: The amount decreases as time increases.

items.prompt: A job pays $72 for 6 hours. Find the rate of change in dollars per hour.
items.tutor_behavior: Use earnings change divided by time change.

items.prompt: A candle is 20 cm tall at hour 0 and 14 cm tall at hour 3. Find the rate in centimeters per hour.
items.tutor_behavior: Height decreases, so the rate is negative.

items.prompt: The equation d=55t+10 models distance d in miles after t hours. What does 55 mean? Answer briefly.
items.tutor_behavior: The coefficient of time is the rate of change.
hint_steps: d is miles and t is hours.
The distance increases 55 miles each hour.

items.prompt: A runner covers 18 miles in 3 hours. Find the rate in miles per hour.
Temperature changes from 70°F to 58°F over 4 hours. Find the rate in °F per hour.
items.tutor_behavior: Compute change in temperature over change in time.

items.prompt: The equation C=8n+25 models cost C dollars for n items. What is the rate of change?
items.tutor_behavior: The coefficient of n is dollars per item.
hint_steps: C is dollars and n is items.

items.prompt: A savings account grows from $100 to $160 in 5 months at a constant rate. Find dollars per month.
items.tutor_behavior: Use change in dollars over months.

items.prompt: A water level falls from 30 cm to 18 cm in 6 minutes. Find centimeters per minute.
The equation B=-4t+60 models battery percentage B after t hours. Interpret -4.
items.answer_key: battery decreases 4 percentage points per hour
accepted_answers: battery decreases 4 percentage points per hour
items.tutor_behavior: A negative coefficient means the battery level decreases as time passes.
hint_steps: B is percentage and t is hours.
Battery decreases 4 percentage points each hour.

items.prompt: A machine makes 150 parts in 5 hours. Find parts per hour.
A population drops from 500 to 440 over 3 years at a constant rate. Find people per year.
The equation P=15h+40 models pay P dollars after h hours. What is the rate of change?
items.tutor_behavior: The coefficient of h is the hourly rate.
hint_steps: P is dollars, h is hours.

items.prompt: A graph rises 24 meters while time increases 6 seconds. Find meters per second.
A tank contains W=-3t+50 gallons after t minutes. Is the water amount increasing or decreasing, and by how many gallons per minute?
items.tutor_behavior: The negative slope shows a decrease of 3 gallons each minute.
hint_steps: The tank loses 3 gallons per minute.
